critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/retailer_portal.py is 10,432 lines — should be split into smaller modules (retailer_catalogue.py, retailer_dispatches.py, retailer_indents.py, etc.). Well above the 700-line guideline.

get_retailer_catalogue_mrp (retailer_portal.py:9729-9847) contains 3 near-identical blocks (yesterday_mrp loop, today_mrp loop, dispatch loop) that all do the same dual-key insertion. Extract a helper `_insert_mrp_and_dual_key(mrp_lookup, product_id, variant_id, mrp_data, piece_products)` to keep this DRY. Ensures the dual-key fix cannot silently regress in one branch but not the others.

The Piece/Packet detection uses `.lower()` on display_unit and matches against a 4-tuple ['Piece','Packet','piece','packet']. Prefer `display_unit.lower() in {'piece','packet'}` — the 4-tuple with duplicates is confusing.
/app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Products.js is 3006 lines — split into ProductForm.js, ProductList.js, ProductVariantsSection.js etc.
Frontend uses a native <select> for the Unit dropdown while other selects use shadcn — inconsistent UX; also triggers the hydration warning noted above.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (MRP): Frontend catalog display looks up MRP by key '{product_id}_unit_piece' (or _unit_packet) for products whose display_unit is Piece/Packet, but backend was only writing keys '{product_id}_{variant_id}'. Result: Piece/Packet products showed no MRP. FIX at retailer_portal.py:9772-9775, 9791-9794, 9833-9837 — pre-builds a `piece_products` map (product_id -> 'unit_piece'/'unit_packet') from db.retailer_catalogue and, whenever a product is encountered in yesterday_mrp / today_mrp / dispatch fallback, also writes an additional entry under the dual key. Verified: 20 piece_products_count in preview DB; Cabbage=35, Cauliflower=45, Bottle Gourd=35 all present at their _unit_piece keys. Bug 2 (dialog): DialogContent didn't cap height, so on shorter viewports the dialog extended past the bottom edge of the screen and the Create Product button was unreachable. FIX at Products.js:1682 — added 'max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto'. Verified: on 768x700 viewport the intrinsic content (968px) is capped at 630px (~90vh) and internally scrollable, so all fields (including Create Product button) are accessible.
